ARTEMIS · initial state · Maine

Maine stands on the v4-improved TreeMap

All 16 Maine counties: TreeMap 2022 repaired with the v4 recipe, a hole model refit on Maine, every accepted pixel added back (no minimum patch area), LETO v1 cellular-automata stands, a speckle cleanup after LETO, and the LETO Maine riparian split. 1,031,648 management units over 17.38M forest acres.

Method 01

Six steps, county by county where memory needs it

01
Grid inputs
Maine grid on TreeMap's lattice; LANDFIRE hole strata, Harris ownership, Hansen loss warped onto it
02
Hole model
AlphaEarth Stage A/B refit on Maine strata; 72 Earth Engine tiles scored
03
v4 raster
county_improvement per county, no minimum patch area, stitched; dated stand age; young-plot IDs
04
FIA
COND/TREE rows for every plot the raster references (ME, MA, NH, NY)
05
LETO
Stage 1 attributes, CA, force_merge; speckle cleanup; riparian split; donor weights
06
Merge
statewide GeoPackage, donor weights, QA
v4 here is bookends only. The v4 rule is bookends_or_obata_and_hansen; Obata covers only one Florida Landsat scene, so obata & hansen is empty in Maine. Hansen still runs and dates the add-back pixels. The EVT gate v3 and the quarry patch rule apply as in FL5.

Layer · young plots 04

41% of add-back acres have no young FIA plot to match

ADR 0003 gives each add-back pixel a new ID with a dated age and a young FIA plot from LETO Maine's states (ME, MA, NH, NY). TreeMap holds few young plots there, so unmatched pixels keep their neighbour plot (UnmatchedYoungPlotPolicy.KEEP_NEIGHBOUR).

Neighbour-kept acres carry a young age with mature structure. Their STAND_AGE_2022 is dated (Hansen 285,395 ac, stratum median 366,497 ac) but BA, QMD and TPA are the mature neighbour's. The forest-type group map is southern: white pine and hemlock fall in other.

Layer · parent stands 06

The speckle cleanup removes 350,489 LETO stands under 5 ac

LETO's force_merge only joins a small stand to a same-owner neighbour. Harris's 10 m ownership, warped to 30 m, leaves single-pixel owners, so LETO keeps 731,084 parents. pipeline/stand_speckle.py then joins every stand under 5 ac that touches another to the neighbour it shares the longest edge with.

Decision · minimum patch area 07

Without the 5 ac minimum, 330,402 more acres go back, and LETO puts 82% of them in stands of 5 ac or more

The add-back rule decides pixel by pixel. county_improvement then dropped 8-connected patches under 5 ac (finalize_add_back.apply_mmu): half of what the rule accepted. LETO and the speckle cleanup already build stands, so Maine now adds back every accepted pixel (common.BASE_MIN_ACRES).

Extra S2 takes its neighbour plot as is. 34,858 of its 209,744 ac are Herb in EVT 2022, forest in 2016 and 2024 but open in 2022, and still carry mature structure. 24,685 extra ac end as isolated islands under 5 ac, which joins the island question.

Closing 10

What the Maine layer establishes, and what it does not

  • A statewide v4 stand layer exists: 380,595 parents, 1,031,648 management units, 2,946 donor plots, every forest acre accounted (MU acres = forest cells).
  • Hole models are regional: the FL fit passes nothing; at the same 5 ac minimum the Maine refit adds back 66,813 ac more than the FL-model run.
  • The raster has no minimum patch area: stand size is LETO's job; 330,402 ac more go back than at 5 ac.
  • The speckle cleanup is a separate post-LETO step; LETO's labels are kept beside it.
  • Young structure is thin: 268,396 add-back acres carry mature structure under a young age.
Open: an owner policy for 6.05M unknown acres; isolated forest islands under 5 ac (keep, LETO's 60 m proximity merge, or drop); 34,858 ac of S2 that EVT 2022 calls Herb keep a mature neighbour plot; EVT gate v3 blocks only warm-temperate pasture (7997); NHDPlus HR HU4 NHDFlowline stands in for v1's NetworkNHDFlowline; Obata covers only Landsat p17/r39 and reads 0 here.
